survivalfly.options.permissions.moderato: Players that bypass spawn protection can use /flight.
survivalfly.options.permissions.gamemast: Players that have higher authority, such as permission to use command blocks, change gamemode, change difficulty, etc. can use /flight.
survivalfly.options.permissions.admin.to: Only operators can use /flight. Admins can also change the flight of others.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.everywhe: Display the Survival Fly menu button on title §oand pause screen.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.bottom_l: Display the Survival Fly menu button at the bottom-left side of the screen.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.bottom_r: Display the Survival Fly menu button at the bottom-right side of the screen.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.title_on: Only display the Survival Fly menu button on title screen.
survivalfly.options.menu_button.off.tool:
Do not display the Survival Fly menu button.
Note: The only way to change this option back is to change this option in the .json/.toml file (depending if you are on forge/fabric)
survivalfly.options.elytra_flight.toolti: Requires the player to wear an elytra to use flight. The elytra's durability will decrement based on the player's flight speed.
survivalfly.options.flight_exhaustion.to: Makes the player hungry when using flight.
survivalfly.options.friendly_flight.tool: Prevents the player from using flight if they have taken any damage within 20 seconds.
survivalfly.options.friendly_flight.play: Prevent flight from player and mob damage.
survivalfly.option_disabled: This option is determined by the server.
